title: Initialize Cargo workspace with core, transit, and reader crates
description:
Create the Cargo.toml workspace manifest and skeleton crate directories for usenet-ipfs-core (rlib), usenet-ipfs-transit (bin), and usenet-ipfs-reader (bin). Set Rust edition 2021 and resolver v2. Add .gitignore entries for target/. Artifact: compilable workspace with `cargo build --workspace` succeeding with no warnings.

Acceptance:
- `cargo build --workspace` succeeds on stable Rust
- Edition 2021, resolver v2 in workspace Cargo.toml
- All three crates present: core (rlib), transit (bin), reader (bin)
- No warnings with `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`
